Yoshi D. Matthews

Independent candidate for United States Senate, Tennessee · Challenger

Nonprofit founder (FTP Nonprofit)

Yoshi D. Matthews is a Goodlettsville, Tennessee resident and founder of FTP Nonprofit. Her campaign site says her background is in business, accounting, nonprofit service and community outreach. She filed as an independent candidate for U.S. Senate on February 2, 2026, and the Tennessee Secretary of State's candidate list shows her petition as approved.

Where Matthews stands

Wages / economy
Proposes a universal basic income, which she says would give eligible Americans a reliable financial foundation and help families meet rising everyday costs.
Wages / economy
Supports lowering the cost of living, supporting working families and small businesses, and promoting economic growth. She cites the ALICE measure, which put 41% of Tennessee households below its threshold in 2024.
Housing
Supports protecting seniors from property taxes, saying no Tennessee senior should lose their home to property taxes after a lifetime of work.
Immigration
Supports securing the border, enforcing immigration laws, and supporting a working legal immigration system.
Education
Supports strengthening education, expanding workforce opportunities, and preparing Tennessee students for careers.
Civil rights / religion
Proposes a narrowly defined, Tennessee-based reparations policy that she describes as fair, lawful, and limited in scope.
Government accountability
Supports term limits, more transparency in federal spending, and performance standards for elected officials.
